errors.text_span: reicht von -150.000 bis 200.000 Mrd. Euro, mit Markierungen in Schritten von 50.000 Mrd. Euro
errors.evidence: The y-axis unit is "Mrd. Euro" (billions of Euros), and the labels are formatted with a dot as a thousands separator (e.g., 200.000 means 200,000 million, which is 200 billion). The description incorrectly interprets this as "200.000 Mrd. Euro" (200,000 billion), which is a factor of 1000 too large. The correct range is -150 to 200 billion Euros.
